Operator can use [UP] or [DOWN] arrow keys to look at a* particular customer and product type's pricing tiers.****************************************************************************

Item.Name: CUSTOMER_ID
Item.Hint: Enter customer ID or use [LISTVAL]; else leave blank.

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_id VARCHAR2(10);
begin
 if :ctrl_blk_1.customer_id is not null
 then
 begin
 select distinct c.customer_id into temp_id
 from customers c, product_pricing_matrix p
 where c.customer_id = :ctrl_blk_1.customer_id
 and c.chapter_id = :g_chapter_id /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 and p.chapter_id = :g_chapter_id
 and p.customer_id = c.customer_id
 and sysdate between p.eff_date and nvl(p.term_date,sysdate+1)
 and sysdate between c.eff_date
 and nvl(c.term_date,sysdate+1);
 exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 begin
 select distinct c.customer_id into temp_id
 from customers c, product_pricing_matrix p
 where upper(name) like :ctrl_blk_1.customer_id || '%'
 and p.chapter_id = :g_chapter_id
 and p.customer_id = c.customer_id
 and c.chapter_id = :g_chapter_id
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 and sysdate between p.eff_date
 and nvl(p.term_date,sysdate+1)
 and sysdate between c.eff_date
 and nvl(c.term_date,sysdate+1);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('0302'); -- invalid customer
 check_package_failure;
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then
 list_values;
 return;
 end;
 end;
 :ctrl_blk_1.customer_id := temp_id;
 end if;
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 NEXT_ITEM;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 tackle_error('Customers');
 check_package_failure;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: CLEAR_CUSTMRS_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure clear_custmrs_details ( checkmaster boolean, opt number ) is
begin
 if ( not checkmaster or ((:custmrs.CUSTOMER_ID is not null)) ) then
 clear_details('pricing_tiers', 'custmrs', opt);
 end if ;
 go_block('custmrs');
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: CLEAR_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure clear_details ( detail VARCHAR2, master VARCHAR2, opt number ) is
begin
 go_block(detail);
 check_package_failure;
 if :system.block_status = 'CHANGED' then
 clear_block(opt);
 if :system.block_status = 'CHANGED' then
 go_block(master);
 raise FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 end if;
 end if;
 clear_block;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: QUERY_CUSTMRS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure query_custmrs is
cursor c1 is
 select distinct p.customer_id, name, product_type
 from product_pricing_matrix p, customers c
 where p.chapter_id = :g_chapter_id
 and p.customer_id = c.customer_id
 and ((:ctrl_blk_1.product_type is null) or
 (product_type = :ctrl_blk_1.product_type))
 and ((:ctrl_blk_1.customer_id is null) or
 (p.customer_id = :ctrl_blk_1.customer_id))
 and sysdate between p.eff_date and nvl(p.term_date,sysdate+365)
 and c.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id; /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
begin
 go_block('custmrs');
 for c1_rec in c1
 loop
 :custmrs.customer_id := c1_rec.customer_id;
 :custmrs.product_type := c1_rec.product_type;
 :custmrs.short_name := c1_rec.name;
 begin
 select life_span, decode(life_span_ind,'H','Hours',
 'D','Days',
 'Y','Years'),
 std_price
 into :custmrs.lifespan,:custmrs.lifespan_ind, :custmrs.std_price
 from vserv_product_types
 where product_type = :custmrs.product_type
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 down;
 end loop;
 up;
 if :system.cursor_value is not null
 then
 go_record('1');
 query_custmrs_details;
 end if;
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('CUSTMRS.SHORT_NAME',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY( 'CUSTMRS.SHORT_NAME', UPDATEABLE, PROPERTY_FALSE );
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: QUERY_CUSTMRS_DETAILS

begin
 if ( (:custmrs.CUSTOMER_ID is not null) and :system.record_status !=
 'NEW' ) then
 query_details('pricing_tiers');
 end if;
 go_block('custmrs');
end;

end;
